unit_cn: Unit 4 Future Living 未来生活
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 4 词表(真词,跳过△超纲/专名);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、未来生活/智能家居/科技主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The future home will take care of nearly all the housework.
words.example_cn: 未来的家几乎会包办所有家务。

words.meaning_cn: 安全;保护措施;安全工作
words.example_en: The home computer will oversee the security of the whole house.
words.example_cn: 家用电脑会监管整座房子的安全。

words.example_en: This discreet electronic servant will control everything in the home.
words.example_cn: 这位不张扬的电子仆人将掌控家中的一切。

words.example_en: The smart system can adjust the temperature and humidity automatically.
words.example_cn: 智能系统能自动调节温度和湿度。

words.example_en: You can change the lighting in any room with a single tap on your phone.
words.example_cn: 你只需在手机上轻点一下就能改变任何房间的灯光。

words.example_en: The home computer will manage all the household gadgets for you.
words.example_cn: 这台家用电脑会替你管理所有家用小装置。

words.example_en: In the future home, robots will do most of the cleaning chores.
words.example_cn: 在未来的家里,机器人会做大部分清洁家务。

words.example_en: Push a button and the walls will move backwards or forwards.
words.example_cn: 按一下按钮,墙壁就会向后或向前移动。

words.example_en: At the touch of a button, the walls slide forwards to make the room smaller.
words.example_cn: 轻触按钮,墙壁就向前滑动,把房间变小。

words.meaning_cn: 综合的;各部分密切协调的;完整统一的
words.example_en: Simply place the clothes in the integrated laundry until they come out ready to wear.
words.example_cn: 只需把衣服放进一体化洗衣装置,出来时就能直接穿了。

words.example_en: The new easy-care fabric never needs ironing after washing.
words.example_cn: 这种免熨烫的新布料洗后无需熨烫。

words.example_en: Each room will have a power wall instead of an electric socket.
words.example_cn: 每个房间都会有一面电力墙,而不是电源插座。

words.example_en: You will be able to attach any electrical appliance to the power wall.
words.example_cn: 你可以把任何电器附在那面电力墙上。

words.example_en: Almost every electrical appliance in the home can be controlled by your phone.
words.example_cn: 家里几乎每件电器都能用手机控制。

words.example_en: A smart home connects every appliance into one network.
words.example_cn: 智能家居把每件电器连成一个网络。

words.meaning_cn: 陈旧的;过时的;不时髦的
words.example_en: Old-fashioned tools such as the duster will soon be gone.
words.example_cn: 像抹布这样过时的工具很快就会消失。

words.example_en: The good old duster will disappear once the air is filtered clean.
words.example_cn: 一旦空气被过滤干净,那老式的抹布就会消失。

words.example_en: The system will filter the air and then scent it with your favourite perfume.
words.example_cn: 系统会过滤空气,再给它加上你最喜欢的香味。

words.example_en: After cleaning, the home will scent the air with a fresh smell.
words.example_cn: 清洁之后,家里会给空气加上清新的香味。

words.example_en: Each room can be filled with your favourite perfume at any time.
words.example_cn: 每个房间随时都能充满你最喜欢的香味。

words.example_en: The sitting-room door will be the entrance to a world full of adventures.
words.example_cn: 客厅的门将成为通往一个充满冒险世界的入口。

words.example_en: Inside the future home you can enjoy endless adventures without leaving your seat.
words.example_cn: 在未来的家里,你足不离座就能享受无尽的冒险。

words.example_en: When you get bored, a simulator can give you any experience from surfing to skiing.
words.example_cn: 当你感到无聊时,模拟器能带给你从冲浪到滑雪的各种体验。

words.example_en: With the simulator, you can try surfing on a huge wave at home.
words.example_cn: 借助模拟器,你能在家里体验在巨浪上冲浪。

words.example_en: At seven in the morning, my lights turn on automatically to wake me up.
words.example_cn: 早上七点,我的灯会自动亮起把我叫醒。

words.example_en: Still sleepy, I find my uniform in the wardrobe and put it on.
words.example_cn: 睡眼惺忪中,我从衣柜里找到校服穿上。

words.example_en: Lina is my family's housekeeper, and she has been with me all my life.
words.example_cn: 莉娜是我家的管家,她陪伴了我一生。

words.example_en: When I was younger, the robot was my nanny and looked after me.
words.example_cn: 我小时候,这个机器人是我的保姆,照顾着我。

words.example_en: The robot was advertised as a reliable helper for busy families.
words.example_cn: 这款机器人被宣传为忙碌家庭的可靠帮手。

words.example_en: A good home robot must be a reliable helper that never lets you down.
words.example_cn: 一个好的家用机器人必须是从不让你失望的可靠帮手。

words.example_en: Each house receives food in a carefully controlled quantity, no more and no less.
words.example_cn: 每户人家收到的食物数量都受到严格控制,不多也不少。

words.example_en: The government says the planet can no longer deal with overpopulation.
words.example_cn: 政府说地球再也无法应对人口过剩了。

words.example_en: Robots perform surgery with less room for error than humans.
words.example_cn: 机器人做手术比人类出错的余地更小。

words.example_en: From my window, all I can see are grey buildings and interconnecting tunnels.
words.example_cn: 从窗口望出去,我只看到灰色的建筑和相互连接的隧道。

words.example_en: We have always walked through the tunnels to get to school.
words.example_cn: 我们一直都是穿过隧道去上学的。

words.example_en: The city is full of grey skyscrapers that all look the same.
words.example_cn: 这座城市满是看上去一模一样的灰色摩天大楼。

words.meaning_cn: 完全相同的;一模一样的
words.example_en: From far away, the buildings are all identical, like grey boxes.
words.example_cn: 从远处看,这些建筑全都一模一样,像灰色的盒子。

words.example_en: I can just spot my school over to the right of the tower.
words.example_cn: 我能勉强看见塔楼右边的学校。

words.example_en: The children in the city have always breathed recycled air.
words.example_cn: 城里的孩子一直呼吸着回收再利用的空气。

words.example_en: Which advance in technology would you most like to have in your future home?
words.example_cn: 你最希望未来的家里拥有哪一项科技进步?

words.example_en: The future home will be any size you fancy at the moment.
words.example_cn: 未来的家会随你心意变成任何你想要的大小。

words.example_en: The smart home is no longer science fiction; it is becoming a reality.
words.example_cn: 智能家居不再是科幻小说,它正在变成现实。

words.example_en: You can connect all the smart devices in your home so they talk to each other.
words.example_cn: 你可以连接家里所有的智能设备,让它们彼此通信。

words.example_en: Any device that uses electricity can be added to your home network.
words.example_cn: 任何用电的设备都可以加入你的家庭网络。

words.example_en: Living in a smart home, you will enjoy much more leisure time.
words.example_cn: 住在智能家居里,你会享有多得多的闲暇时间。

words.example_en: Smart homes are especially useful for elderly people who wish to live independently.
words.example_cn: 智能家居对希望独立生活的老年人尤其有用。

words.example_en: Robots now work in labs and even perform surgery in hospitals.
words.example_cn: 如今机器人在实验室工作,甚至在医院做手术。

words.example_en: I walk to the window and look out over the grey landscape of the city.
words.example_cn: 我走到窗前,望着城市灰蒙蒙的景色。
